newsitem.title: USA: Rennsselaer Cty, NY, seeks green bond funds--paper.
newsitem.headline: Rennsselaer Cty, NY, seeks green bond funds--paper.

text.p: Rennsselaer County, N.Y., has applied for over $20 million in money from the Environmental Bond Act that voters approved last November, according to the Troy Record's Monday edition.
The list of requests includes $2 million to cap the Troy municipal landfill, $5 million to create a water district in Brunswick, and $6 million to restore the county courthouse.
The state legislature is expected to start distributing funds under the $1.75 billion act over the next three to four months, the County Executive told the paper.
